output.sql: SELECT p.method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments p WHERE p.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY total_amount DESC
output.explanation: Payments are filtered to those with paid_at in calendar year 2025, then grouped by payment method. For each method the query counts the payments and adds up their amounts, rounded to 2 decimals. The results are sorted by total amount, largest first.
